title: Covering up bias in CelebA-like datasets with Markov blankets: A post-hoc cure for attribute prior avoidance
reasoning: The paper identifies and proposes a technical solution to mitigate biases (e.g., racial and gender stereotypes) in generative models, which have ethical implications related to fairness and representation. However, its primary focus is on a technical methodology to correct these biases, rather than a component of evaluating or benchmarking broader ethical frameworks, morals, or faith itself.
